This experience has completely destroyed my confidence in LG. Switching to Bosch and Daikin and for the OLED TV's I'll be going with Sony.Recommendation:If you're considering DFB532FP, be aware the lower rack design differs significantly from DFB424FP despite identical specifications shown online. Test with YOUR plates before purchase. Don't trust the website comparison tool or dealer information.The wash quality is decent when it actually fits your dishes, but misleading product information and terrible service support make this a 1-star experience.I was deeply inspired by LG India MD Hong Ju Jeon's Hindi speech at the NSE listing ceremony on 14th October 2024, where he emphasized LG's commitment to understanding Indian consumer needs. Just four days later, on 18th October 2025, I purchased the DFB532FP for my new home in Himachal Pradesh that's how much his words resonated with me, guess it's all word play and zero action.I'll be giving this machine to relatives who use smaller plates and I have to look for a better option.

Comments (English): [ Ultra quiet and cleans like a champ (Grade: A) ] || ---------------- || This unit replaces an 18 year old KitchenAid dishwasher. First, the finish repels finger prints, dog nose prints, dirt, and other things that could make the surface dirty. It holds a few more dishes than my previous dishwasher, as the racks are better designed and has the additional third rack (top rack). The controls are about the same as the previous model, with a 4-hour delayed start (we run the dishwasher in the middle of the night because electricity rates are better so the 4-hour delay was essential). We will often press buttons accidentally when opening or closing the dishwasher door, which will cause the dishwasher to make a chime noise but isn't a big deal. The dishwasher is ultra quiet when it does run and I appreciate this. Sometimes we need to run a load during the day and you can barely tell it is running when in the same room and can't hear it at all from other rooms. The previous dishwasher wanted you to know when it was running, because it was much much louder. The jets in this unit must be well placed because I haven't had a dish come out dirty yet. The previous dishwasher had an occasional bowl or dish that wouldn't come clean. Time will tell if this dishwasher holds up or if the jets continue to run without issue, but based on initial quality and performance I would give this dishwasher a solid "A" grade. If the controls were better placed or didn't get touched during the door open/close, I would have given an A+.

Sentence (English): I read multiple reviews and did a ton of research before settling on this particular model.
Comments (English): I read multiple reviews and did a ton of research before settling on this particular model. If the Bosch brand is out of your budget, this is a close alternative. Very quiet, cleans well, and the 3rd shelf is a major upgrade from our previous dishwasher. I'm a handyman, so I've installed several dishwashers over the years. Needless to say, but I didn't have any issues after installing. I did upgrade to a new water line, which I recommend. No leaks at all, which was an issue that I had read in some of the reviews. Install it the right way, keep an eye on it underneath (I set paper towls around the water connection areas to spot small drips), and I don't expect it will leak. Take your time, do it right, replace old water lines (I also replaced the shut off valve with a quarter turn valve, because mine was old), and you shouldn't have any issues. Cheers.

Despite multiple requests to correct my contact information, the issue persisted. I escalated the matter to Sedgwick and GE. Sedgwick did not respond to multiple contacts, including a certified letter sent in December. GE was also notified by certified letter and email. As of Dec. 31, the matter remains unresolved.

All in all no regrets with this dishwasher

Sentence (English): I recently bought this Dishwasher and love the matte black door.
Comments (English): [ Quiet Operation and Efficient Dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || I recently bought this Dishwasher and love the matte black door. It has a nice dispenser and 3 rows of cleaning increase the capacity of dishes and utensils that it can hold.I do not like that I am unable to see how much longer it would take for the dishwasher to be finished. I can see some numbers peeking out on top of the dishwasher but my counter covers them. I'm not sure that it was intended for me to see these numbers or if my counter comes out more than others. When the dishwasher is in dryer mode I do see a red light on front and then a whitish light when done. If I am not around to see the red light I really am not sure at what part of the cycle the dishwasher is in It would have been better to have a green light appear when the machine has finished.My machine does not have fold down tines on the bottom shelf- which would offer more options to load the machine. I am still having trouble deciding how to place my large and small dishes and bowls. On the middle some mugs sit funny in the inner rows and the outer row doesn't accomodate more than 4 glasses if I want a plastic tine to separate them. I do like that the top rack has multiple levels and angles and that there is a utensil tray to hold a bunch of sliverware or smaller items. It's nice that is also removable. I don't always use the large utensil holder that sits on the bottom rack to make more room for dishes, large bowls, pots, etc. I use a round cup from a dish drain that sits on my middle rack to hold an overflow of silverware.I love the stainless interior and would never get a different interior.I would have given this machine a 5 star if not for the several criticisms stated above. I', not sure if any machine would meet all of my criteria but so far I do really like this dishwasher. I use the express cycle and pro heat most often - my dishes do get rinsed off before I put them in so that I do not need a more extended cycle. They dry nicely on this cycle as well.

I bought the full Samsung Bespoke set in April 2024 and now Dec 2025 the dishwasher, microwave, and stove each have small plastic pieces that have broken off. I don't love cooking so my appliances are not even used daily and yet look like I they have taken a serious beating. I'm truly disappointed because they used to be beautiful and I love the look of them, other than the chips now missing due to normal cleaning and a little bit of usage wear and tear.

Sentence (English): Do Not purchase - what a nightmare!
Comments (English): [ Do Not Buy ] || ---------------- || Do Not purchase - what a nightmare! Purchased in November. Store associate advised I needed a new hose hookup, no further questions, agreed, added it and paid. Delivery set for a few days later. Delivery/install tech takes one look and says the hoses that were ordered are too short bc the dishwasher is one cabinet width away from the sink. Installers inexplicably do not have a supply of longer hoses on the truck. I reschedule the install for a week later - installed and working fine for 3 days before leaking all over the floor. Chat with HD support 3 times, - each time getting disconnected before a resolution is made and having to start over. Called HD support, on hold for 30 minutes, they made a claim with GE. GE tech comes out to investigate and replaces the door seal and sees the bottom spray arm has contacted the heating element and melted a hole in the end. He indicated a design change where medal clips to prevent this issue were removed from the spray arm. New spray arm comes in - 3 washes later the same thing happens. Tech comes out again and the GE engineers now plan to replace the heating element as well as add a third spray arm. Unrelated to above - the tech needed to manually bend the bottom rack to allow it to slide in without the silverware bin contacting the right edge of the unit. The top rack had to be replaced because it did not fully slide out of the unit. Overall, i'm at 6 weeks of ownership - took 2 weeks to install, am outside of HD return policy and have to fight GE to replace the unit instead of repeatedly trying to fix individual units. I have a duct taped spray arm to try to prevent leaks, but cannot use heated drying. Overall not Happy with the HD experience or the GE profile unit. I replaced a Bosch that failed at 10 years old - wish i had stayed with that brand.

Sentence (English): This is a review of a 12-seater Dios dishwasher, purchased with my own money.
Comments (English): [ This is one of the appliances I wish I had bought a long time ago. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a 12-seater Dios dishwasher, purchased with my own money. I've been a working mom for 10 years. Still, I was so complacent that I thought I could wash dishes by hand that I neglected the kids for a while. Then, I got a serious case of the flu. Seeing myself washing dishes while sick made me realize this wasn't right, so I ordered it right away. It was installed within two days of ordering. Delivery was seriously the best. I was debating between a 14-seater and a 12-seater, but I decided on the 12-seater because I thought it would be enough for a family of four. And while it's only a small difference from a 2-seater, the price difference is significant. When it arrived, it was even smaller than I expected. My kitchen is cramped, so I was a bit worried. Fortunately, I found a dresser that fit perfectly. I gave up on two drawers and installed it right under the stove. I'm thinking about switching to an induction cooktop soon. The sink drainer is a bit higher than in my other house. The technician worked hard. But he explained things calmly and clearly, and the installation was really neat and tidy! There's a similar model with three tiers available at another online store, but the price is about 150,000 won more. The dishes won't be different anyway, so I chose the two-tier model because I thought it would be easier to store pots and pans. After actually using it, I found out that it was easy to clean. There were no water stains, and the automatic door-opening function made it so easy to use! I wish I'd bought it sooner. It's not without its inconveniences, but it's definitely convenient! Kitchen life, which is becoming more and more convenient, is the best.

Sentence (English): Review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I am very satisfied with the installation that was done on the specified date. ] || ---------------- || Review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher. The appliance I was most excited about during my recent kitchen remodel was a built-in dishwasher. Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Wi-Fi를 통한 스마트씽큐(SmartThinQ) 연동으로 외부에서도 세척 상태를 확인하거나 예약 세척을 설정할 수 있었다. 저녁에 식사를 마치고 세척 예약을 해두면 아침에 깨끗하게 처리된 식기를 바로 사용할 수 있어 매우 편리하다.또한, 식기 종류에 맞춘 다양한 모드(강력, 표준, 절약, 유리, 빠른세척 등)가 있어 상황에 맞는 프로그램을 선택하는 재미도 있다. 특히 “빠른 세척 모드”는 간단한 식기만 사용할 때 빠르게 처리할 수 있어 실사용 만족도가 높았다.⸻ 수납 편의성 & 공간 활용14인용이라 수납 공간이 넉넉한 것이 가장 큰 장점이다. 여러 개의 접시, 깊은 그릇, 국그릇, 컵, 컵받침까지 한 번에 넣고도 공간이 남아 여유롭다. 2단 구조와 접이식 랙은 크기에 따라 유연하게 조절할 수 있어 대형 냄비나 프라이팬도 문제 없이 들어간다.아이들 식기, 유리컵, 플라스틱 용기까지 다양한 형태의 식기를 함께 넣을 수 있는 점도 장점이다. 전용 랙이 잘 설계돼 있어 물이 고이거나 움직임으로 인한 충격에 의한 소음도 적었다.⸻ 아쉬운 점아쉬운 점이라면 기존 싱크대와의 완전 빌트인 호환 여부를 체크하는 초기 설치 난이도 정도이다. 설치 전 치수와 마감재, 주변 공간 구조를 꼼꼼히 확인해야 깔끔하게 빌트인 설비를 마칠 수 있다. 다소 전문 설치기사의 도움이 필요한 경우가 많다는 점이, DIY를 선호하는 사람에게는 작은 불편이 될 수 있다.⸻ 총평LG전자 디오스 오브제컬렉션 빌트인 식기세척기 14인용은✔ 뛰어난 세척력✔ 안정적인 고온 살균·건조✔ 스마트 연동 편의 기능✔ 넉넉한 수납량✔ 인테리어를 완성하는 깔끔한 디자인까지 가정용 최고 수준의 식기세척기라고 평가할 수 있다. 살림살이가 많거나 식기 관리에 부담을 느끼는 가정이라면, 이 제품으로 식기 설거지 고민을 크게 줄일 수 있다. 무엇보다 매일 반복되는 설거지에서 해방되는 편리함이야말로 이 제품이 가져다주는 진짜 만족 포인트다.

The appliance I was most excited about during my recent kitchen remodel was a built-in dishwasher. Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Dishwashers not only reduce dishwashing time, but also manage water and detergent consumption efficiently, and offer a noticeable difference in cleaning power compared to hand washing, which has been a huge hit with my entire family. The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, especially, exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. Design & First Impressions. True to the Objet Collection series, the exterior design is remarkably sophisticated. The built-in style blends seamlessly into the kitchen interior, without detracting from the overall aesthetic. The integrated panel creates a clean and luxurious feel, and the intuitive front display ensures minimal visual distraction during use. The generous 14-seat storage capacity offers ample space for both the family and guests, making it a perfect choice for space utilization. Cleaning Performance. The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-Person offers outstanding cleaning power, reliable high-temperature sterilization and drying, convenient smart connectivity features, ample storage space, and a clean design that complements the interior. It can be considered a top-tier dishwasher for households with a large household or those concerned about dishwashing. This product can significantly reduce dishwashing headaches. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

The LG Dios dishwasher's greatest strength is its exceptional cleaning power. When I loaded my dishes and ran the standard program, grease and food residue were thoroughly removed from dishes, plates, and cups. I could clearly feel the difference in cleaning power, especially on stubborn grease and stubborn food like rice. Even stains that would easily be left by hand washing due to the angle and water pressure were thoroughly removed. The water jet pattern inside the dishwasher meticulously sprays water from various directions, ensuring even distribution, and the high-temperature wash mode leaves virtually no stains on dishes. I was most impressed by the fact that cups and glasses were cleaned cleanly, with no residue or stains. Drying Power & Hygiene. LG dishwashers offer excellent drying performance. When I opened the door after a wash cycle, hot steam escaped, leaving virtually no water stains inside. The automatic drying function also dries cups, which tend to collect water, relatively quickly, reducing concerns about mold and odor. Hygiene-wise, the high-temperature wash and sterilization function is a major strength. Even items requiring more hygiene, such as baby dishes, cutting boards, and knives, can be washed at higher water temperatures, providing a level of safety comparable to a hospital-grade dishwasher, despite being a household dishwasher. Convenient Features & Smart Connectivity. As expected from LG, the dishwasher is well-equipped with smart features. SmartThinQ integration via Wi-Fi allowed me to check the washing status and set a scheduled wash even when I was away. Setting a scheduled wash after dinner was incredibly convenient, as I could use the freshly cleaned dishes right away in the morning. Furthermore, various modes (Strong, Standard, Economy, Glass, Quick Wash, etc.) tailored to different dish types allowed me to choose the right program for the situation. The Quick Wash mode, in particular, was particularly satisfying, as it quickly processed simple dishes. Storage Convenience & Space Utilization. The ample storage space, designed for 14 people, is a major advantage. Even with multiple plates, deep bowls, soup bowls, cups, and coasters, there's still plenty of room. The two-tier structure and foldable rack can be flexibly adjusted to accommodate various sizes, allowing for the seamless storage of large pots and frying pans. Another advantage is its ability to accommodate a variety of dishes, including children's dishes, glass cups, and plastic containers. The dedicated rack is well-designed, minimizing water pooling and noise caused by impacts from movement. One drawback is the initial installation difficulty, which requires checking the compatibility with the existing sink. Carefully checking the dimensions, finish, and surrounding space before installation ensures a clean, built-in installation. The fact that professional installation often requires the assistance of a professional installer can be a minor inconvenience for DIY enthusiasts. Above all, the convenience of being free from the daily chore of washing dishes is the true satisfaction this product brings.

Sentence (English): It was super simple to replace the old dishwasher with this one.
Comments (English): [ Super quiet, works great ] || ---------------- || It was super simple to replace the old dishwasher with this one. We rented the $20 truck and brought it home. It uses fingerprint-less stainless steel that works great (unlike the fingerprint prior non-stainless stainless steel). Easy to swap out. Looks great--and the inside was also all stainless. Love the trays that can go up or down, plus the additional silverware rack. Everything comes out very clean. But the best feature--it is SUPER quiet (vs our prior noisy one). We had to pick up a plastic handle sign, "Do Not Open" we used when it was running so grandma (hard of hearing) wouldn't open it mid-cycle (and not know how to re-start). And I mean SUPER quiet--we don't have to turn up the living room TV when it is on! I got it during the end of the year rotation--got there super early since they go quick. The one I was there for was 2 levels down from this--but it was gone in seconds. This was the highest-level dishwasher, but it only cost me about $100 more because of the "in-store" model discount or I may not have considered this higher-end unit. I am glad I got it--for the silence alone. It is a pleasure to use. Even simple things like having top and side screws so it would never move. Plus, the door doesn't take much to open (magnetic? ) so it doesn't pull on the unit. Time will tell if it has any issues--but the reviews were great (coming from a super shopper). Love it.

Comments (English): [ Love this Smart LG Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Absolutely love this smart LG Dishwasher. I replaced an older model dishwasher with this energy-efficient dishwasher. This is a 24-inch wide dishwasher, with a nice stainless steel front, which is print proof. This dishwasher can be linked with the LG ThinQ app, if desired. The digital control panel display is convenient and easy to use. There is an interior light that illuminates when the door is opened. The light will turn off after about four minutes and thirty seconds, if left open. There are three racks with nice sturdy pulls at the front, which is a nice feature. The upper small rack can hold smaller items. It also has a rinse aid indicator, if the reservoir becomes low. No more guessing if it's low or empty. There are TrueSteam nozzles in the door. During dry boost mode, don't be alarmed when the door chimes and then pops open during the additional drying time. This startled me at first, but after quickly reading the manual, determined this was normal. The installation took me about an hour to complete. I used a new water line and wiring kit. The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow. I've had this dishwasher for a short period of time, but most say I've been impressed with the cleaning of my dishes the couple of times I've used it. I used the one-hour cycle with and without the low dry boost setting and can say my dishes have been clean both times. There is an outer light at the bottom of the dishwasher that will stay on during operation. After it is complete, there will be a chime, bottom light turns off after 90 seconds and the control panel will display “END” for 30 seconds. I personally like these features. There are many more features and washing settings this dishwasher has. Read through the manual and choose what's best for your needs. I didn't realize how loud my previous model was compared to this quiet LG dishwasher, which is so nice on the ears. Overall, I am very happy with the performance and functionality of this LG dishwasher. The cleanliness of dishes hasn't disappointed thus far. I will continue to learn what this machine can do through all the different cycles, as I get more and more comfortable with it.

Comments (English): [ Excellent Build Quality, Exceptional Cleaning & Possibly Quietest Machine You Can Buy ] || ---------------- || Purchased the Bosch SHP78 about a month ago to replace a 30-year old Maytag. Installation was simple and I was able to install it nearly flush with the cabinet facing, although you can pretty much mount it any way you want.It's an amazing machine and top-rated by Consumer Reports; in fact, it exceeded my expectations. All cycles are amazingly quiet and the question becomes, "Is it running? ". The only noise you'll probably hear is the water draining into the sink's plumbing system; yes, it's that quiet.Performance: I left dried-on Malt-O-Meal on a sauce pan as well as another with mac 'n' cheese residue. Using the 'normal' cycle, regular temp water, etc., both came out spotless, plus, the copper bottoms on 40-year old Revere Ware saucepans is a lot brighter, too. Another bonus: powdered dishwasher detergent had left a whitish residue on a chrome colander that defied cleaning. It's now about one more wash from having it's original clean look. That's probably a combo of the dishwasher and the detergent used; ditch the powdered stuff. Can't say enough good things about the Bosch, though. The build quality (USA) is exceptional and the fit and finish is nicer than I've seen on any appliance. It's pricey but I don't expect I'll have to replace it any time soon, either.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is amazing compared to my previous machine.
Comments (English): [ And an amazing appliance that has reinvented the dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is amazing compared to my previous machine. This LG appliance has so many upgrades, including a downloadable app for customize ringtones and wash cycles not to mention a reminder in 30 wash cycles to run a sanitize solution. The downloadable app with the Wi-Fi feature is not necessary to use the machine, but is available if you want to expand on different options, I went ahead and downloaded the Christmas jingle bells ringtone. You'll notice right away when installing you have a carpet material surrounding machine to dampen noise and prevent heat from escaping. The installment of this machine is very similar to your previous model, hardwired power supply, water supply, and last part of small hose feeding into the sink for dirty water.Now, for some more awesome highlights about this machine, you have two spray arms. I've got to let you know a huge bonus for me is how smooth the racks slide in and out - Not to mention a LED light Inside the machine that comes on after you open the door. This machine has so many features. Another one includes a steam nozzle that's built in the door you'll notice after opening at the bottom. Just a heads up in the last 10 minutes of operation, the door will automatically crack open, allow air to escape, which is part of the drying cycle. You have to believe me this machine is the best investment you could buy. I highly recommended to any customer.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher last week to replace our Whirlpool dishwasher that was only about 2 years old.
Comments (English): [ So much better than our old dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher last week to replace our Whirlpool dishwasher that was only about 2 years old. Our old dishwasher was so frustrating. It left soap on our dishes, took 4+ hours to turn off, only had hot water on the sani-clean cycle. Sometimes, I am not sure it even cleaned our dishes. After months of worrying about whether our dishes (particularly utensils that may have raw meat on them), I gave up and we bought the Maytag dishwasher. The first time I washed our dishes I was amazed at how clean and squeaky they were. I promptly took all my dishes out of the cupboard and all my silverware and rewashed them. They were all so clean and shiny! I was elated! Needless to say the Maytag dishwasher cleaned my dishes very well and it only took 2+ hours on just heated dry. So far….I love this dishwasher! Merry Christmas to me!

Sentence (English): I purchased this to replace a 15 year-old high end KitchenAid dishwasher that worked pretty flawlessly for a decade and a half.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher; odd engineering ] || ---------------- || I purchased this to replace a 15 year-old high end KitchenAid dishwasher that worked pretty flawlessly for a decade and a half. The features and interior engineering of this DWTS424 are good and it seems to clean well. There is a bit of a louder/odd noise when it is in the pro washing mode so I will keep an eye on that – hopefully it was just a pot angled the wrong way.From an engineering standpoint, however, I am disappointed. In these new models, there's a lot more plastic components that were metal in the older models - for example, some of the underbody components, front kickplate, etc. The installation was also vastly more difficult given the way the plastic framing extends down to the floor and through the front of the dishwasher is now present – older models did not have that.It made working with my waterline, drain hose, and electrical hookup very, very difficult. It took an act of Congress for me to figure out how to fish my electrical line from where it comes up through the floor through the underbody components and through the hole in the electrical box underneath.The old model also had a preinstalled hose that gave me flexibility on where the drain line would go – but this model had a very odd location and an angle for the drain line that also made the install very difficult. I ended up having to run the drain line up behind the dishwasher, which did not allow me to push it all the way into the cabinets for a flush install.I'm hopeful that - beyond the engineering and install headaches - this dishwasher will last as long as or longer than as the last, as we've stayed loyal to KitchenAid for all of our major (high end) kitchen appliances.

Sentence (English): Purchased the Bosch SHP78 about a month ago to replace a 30-year old Maytag.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Build Quality, Exceptional Cleaning & Possibly Quietest Machine You Can Buy ] || ---------------- || Purchased the Bosch SHP78 about a month ago to replace a 30-year old Maytag. Installation was simple and I was able to install it nearly flush with the cabinet facing, although you can pretty much mount it any way you want. It's an amazing machine and top-rated by Consumer Reports; in fact, it exceeded my expectations. All cycles are amazingly quiet and the question becomes, "Is it running? ". The only noise you'll probably hear is the water draining into the sink's plumbing system; yes, it's that quiet. Performance: I left dried-on Malt-O-Meal on a sauce pan as well as another with mac 'n' cheese residue. Using the 'normal' cycle, regular temp water, etc., both came out spotless, plus, the copper bottoms on 40-year old Revere Ware saucepans is a lot brighter, too. Another bonus: powdered dishwasher detergent had left a whitish residue on a chrome colander that defied cleaning. It's now about one more wash from having it's original clean look. That's probably a combo of the dishwasher and the detergent used; ditch the powdered stuff. Can't say enough good things about the Bosch, though. The build quality (USA) is exceptional and the fit and finish is nicer than I've seen on any appliance. It's pricey but I don't expect I'll have to replace it any time soon, either.

Comments (English): [ Is it wrong to love a dishwasher? ] || ---------------- || I guess I should hold off a star for longevity, but I am just so thrilled with my new dishwasher I had to give it all five stars. Unfortunately, the guys were not able to do the install at the time of delivery due to my dishwasher not having a cut off. Some may find this helpful. Even though I knew where the main cut off was, I was told that would not be wise because the next person may not notice and end up flooding my kitchen. I was so disappointed. I thought I had everything covered. I had cleared everything out, I had an outlet installed (the old dishwasher was hardwired), and yet my new dishwasher was still left out in the garage. Even so, the guys assured me, they had done everything else, including attaching the power cord. Two (2) days and $195 later ($45 parts & $150 fee), I had a working dishwasher. Now for the nitty-gritty, Not only is it beautiful, it is super quiet. Not just quiet when it starts, it's quiet throughout the entire process. So much so that it illuminates underneath to let you know it's in use, that is just cool. When the cycle is over, and the job is completely finished, it plays a cute little jingle, a little longer than a tone, to let you know it's done, the door opens just slightly, and End is displayed on the screen. Speaking of the screen, it is fantastic. The guessing game is over. Once the job is selected, the run time is clearly displayed on the screen and the count down begins. Of course I'm impressed, my previous dishwasher was at least 15 years old; however, one of my friends stopped by and she was more impressed than I especially since she thought her relatively new dishwasher was super quiet, she was wrong. It was so quiet that she stayed until the cycle was over because she kept expecting a roar to start, again, she was wrong. I am just delighted. I'm even smiling as I record this review which seems rather ridiculous for a dishwasher, but I'm in love. Plus, it has ThinQ. I really don't know exactly what ThinQ is but I am certain it will become a helpful tool. In fact it has already proven to be beneficial. Once I downloaded the app, added my dishwasher, I was able to redeem an additional warranty, if it qualifies, just by scanning the QR code.
